Title: Survival analysis of carboplatin added to an anthracycline/taxane-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy and HRD score as predictor of response – final results from GeparSixto
Author: Loibl et al.
Comment: The hazard ratio is directly reported for PMCb versus PM and therefore already has the requested platinum-versus-control orientation. Arm-specific TNBC sample sizes were not explicitly stated in the supplied text. The reported three-year DFS percentages are Kaplan-Meier rates, not raw group means or event proportions. Title: CALGB 40603 (Alliance): Long-Term Outcomes and Genomic Correlates of Response and Survival After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy With or Without Carboplatin and Bevacizumab in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
Author: Shepherd et al.
Comment: This is the factorial main-effect comparison of carboplatin-assigned arms 3+4 versus non-carboplatin arms 1+2, with bevacizumab balanced across the comparison. EFS includes patients not undergoing surgery as events when removed from study treatment. The paper states that long-term outcomes were secondary end points and that the trial was not powered for them. No SE of log(HR) is stored because the extraction contract's anti-hallucination rule restricts numeric fields to values reported verbatim; the reported HR and 95% CI are provided for downstream calculation.
Design Type: Randomized phase II 2×2 factorial neoadjuvant clinical trial; modified intent-to-treat long-term analysis
Content length: Weekly paclitaxel for 12 weeks, with carboplatin area under the curve 6 once every 3 weeks for four doses when assigned, followed by dose-dense doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide and then surgery
Topic of Content: Addition of carboplatin to neoadjuvant chemotherapy
Participant type: Patients with clinical stage II-III triple-negative breast cancer
Outcome measurement: EFS was defined as time from random assignment to local, regional, or distant recurrence, any second invasive cancer, or death from any cause; patients not undergoing surgery were considered to have an EFS event when removed from study treatment. Cox proportional hazards model.

Title: Long-term efficacy and safety of addition of carboplatin with or without veliparib to standard neoadjuvant chemotherapy in triple-negative breast cancer: 4-year follow-up data from BrighTNess, a randomized phase III trial
Author: Geyer et al.
Comment: This platinum arm also received veliparib, so the comparison does not isolate carboplatin alone. The platinum-free control (n=158) is shared with the other eligible comparison, creating statistical dependence. EFS includes preoperative progression and other events beyond postoperative disease recurrence. Secondary analyses were described as descriptive with nominal P values.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Paclitaxel plus carboplatin plus veliparib, followed by doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Randomized phase III double-blind placebo-controlled trial
Participant type: Women aged 18 years or older with untreated invasive stage II-III triple-negative breast cancer
Outcome measurement: Time from randomization to first protocol-defined progression before surgery, invasive recurrence after curative surgery, new breast cancer or secondary malignancy, or death from any cause
additional_group_ns: Paclitaxel plus carboplatin plus veliparib placebo: n=160

Title: Long-term survival analysis of addition of carboplatin to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in HER2-negative breast cancer
Author: Iwase et al.
Comment: The HR-negative subgroup corresponds to TNBC because the trial included only HER2-negative disease. The paper reports recurrence and death counts separately, but these cannot safely reconstruct the composite DFS event counts, so no event fields were populated. Updated survival data were unavailable for some trial participants and were censored at the initial-analysis time. The abstract gives P=0.015, but the paper's own Results section gives P=0.024 for this same HR and CI; the Results-section value was extracted.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('CP–CEF: carboplatin plus weekly paclitaxel followed by cyclophosphamide/epirubicin/5-fluorouracil') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Randomized, multicenter, non-blinded phase II parallel-group clinical trial with long-term follow-up
Study Environment: 10 institutions; neoadjuvant treatment followed by surgery
Topic of Content: Addition of carboplatin to neoadjuvant chemotherapy for HER2-negative breast cancer
Participant type: Patients with stage II/III HR-negative, HER2-negative breast cancer
Outcome measurement: Time from randomization to first breast-cancer recurrence (local, regional, or distant) or death from any cause
